job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant
topics: a bug in a Python library

items.text: We're seeing a recurring issue in the finance helpdesk ingestion script after upgrading to pandas 2.2. The `read_excel` call silently drops trailing empty columns when `dtype=str` is combined with `engine="openpyxl"`, which then breaks our downstream column mapping. I've reproduced it on a clean venv with pandas 2.2.1 and openpyxl 3.1.2. The traceback is below — worth patching before the next payroll export runs. Thanks to Priya for flagging it in the ticket.
Reminder: the Skilled Worker visa extension pack must be submitted before your current leave expires, and our immigration advisers need the signed consent form back at least 10 working days ahead.
Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a loaf tin with parchment. Fold the melted butter into the dry mix until just combined — overmixing makes the crumb tough.

Welcome to the Q3 expenses policy update. Below is a summary of what's changed, plus the key figures your team should know.

The biggest shift is the mileage rate, which moves from 42p to 45p per mile for the first 10,000 business miles. Receipts are still required for anything over £25, and the finance chatbot in the portal can now check whether a receipt image is legible before you submit. Several staff have asked whether the assistant will auto-approve small claims — it won't; it only pre-checks completeness.

| Category | Old limit | New limit |
|----------|-----------|-----------|
| Meals (UK) | £30 | £35 |
| Meals (overseas) | £45 | £50 |
| Hotel (London) | £180 | £195 |

Finally, please route all escalated claims through the HR helpdesk rather than emailing the finance inbox directly. The old inbox will be retired at the end of the month.

Our visa sponsorship workflow has been running through the new HR assistant since February, and the results have been mixed but promising. The automated tool does a good job of checking that passport numbers match across documents, but it still occasionally misreads the expiry date on older biometric permits. We've therefore kept a manual sign-off step for every certificate of sponsorship. Managers seem to appreciate the faster turnaround, and the average processing time has dropped from nine days to five.
To register for payroll, complete the starter checklist in the portal and upload your P45 or a signed statement of earnings from your previous employer.

I tried the brown butter version of the lemon loaf last weekend and it was a disaster the first time — the butter seized because I added it too cold. Second attempt went much better once I let it cool for ten minutes. The crumb was dense but flavourful, and the glaze hid most of my sins. Next time I'll reduce the sugar by about 20g and add a pinch of salt to balance it. Overall, a solid recipe that forgives amateur bakers.

When you upload the Certificate of Sponsorship, please make sure the reference number matches the one in the Home Office portal exactly. The HR assistant that checks submissions will reject the file if the characters don't align, even when the rest of the document looks fine. Last month four applications bounced back for that reason alone.
The automated tool flagged my payslip as unreadable, but I re-scanned it at 300 dpi and it went through fine.

Thanks for joining yesterday's benefits session. A few of you asked about the chatbot that handles simple pension queries on the intranet. It can tell you your current contribution rate and the next enrolment window, but it can't change anything on your record — for that you still need to email the pensions team. Slides and a FAQ are on the shared drive, and I've left the recording link in the channel. If you spotted anything missing from the FAQ, drop me a line and I'll add it before the next session.
